title: Cobbledex X Field Guide Compat Scan
description: Unofficial compat bridge between Cobbledex and Field Guide — use the Cobbledex as a spyglass to scan and register Pokémon in both mods at once.
body:
# Cobbledex × Field Guide Compat

An **unofficial compatibility bridge** between [Cobbledex](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledex) and [Field Guide](https://modrinth.com/mod/field-guide) for **Cobblemon 1.5.2** (Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge).

This mod does **not** replace or modify either mod — it simply teaches them to talk to each other, so scanning a Pokémon with Field Guide's spyglass mechanic also registers it in your Cobbledex, and the Cobbledex itself becomes usable as a scanning spyglass.

## What it does

- **The Cobbledex works as a spyglass.** Shift + right-click the Cobbledex to start channeling it just like a vanilla spyglass — complete with zoom and its own lens overlay.
- **Dual registration.** Whenever a scan completes (whether through a normal spyglass or through the Cobbledex itself), the scanned Pokémon is registered in **both** Field Guide *and* the Cobbledex as "seen."
- **Dynamic zoom.** While channeling, scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in/out smoothly, from a subtle 1.1x up to 5x magnification. Your zoom level is remembered between uses.
- **Scan HUD.** A progress bar ("Identifying...") appears while a scan is in progress; once complete, the Pokémon's name and an "Added!" confirmation fade in and out.
- **Sound feedback.** Distinct sounds for opening the scope, adjusting zoom, an ongoing "scanning" beep that rises in pitch as the scan progresses, and a confirmation chime on completion.
- **Immersive view.** Your hand/item is hidden while looking through the lens, just like the vanilla spyglass.

## Controls

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| **Shift + right-click** with the Cobbledex | Enter spyglass mode: zoom + lens overlay + Field Guide scan reticle. On completion, registers in **both** Field Guide and the Cobbledex. |
| **Right-click** (no shift) with the Cobbledex | Cobbledex's original behavior is untouched — registers the nearest Pokémon as seen, opens its entry, or opens the collection GUI. |
| **Mouse wheel** (while channeling) | Adjusts zoom level dynamically (1.1x–5x). |
| **Normal spyglass** on a Pokémon | Scans as usual with Field Guide, and now also registers the Pokémon in the Cobbledex. |

## Requirements

This is a **compatibility patch**, not a standalone mod. You need all of the following installed:

- [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) 1.5.2 (Forge, 1.20.1)
- [Cobbledex](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledex) 1.1.0
- [Field Guide](https://modrinth.com/mod/field-guide) 1.8.3
- Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

> ⚠️ Built and tested against the specific versions above. Other versions of Cobbledex or Field Guide may not be compatible, since the bridge hooks into their internal APIs.

## Notes

- This is a fan-made, unofficial addon. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the authors of Cobbledex, Field Guide, or Cobblemon.
- No assets, code, or resources from those mods are included or redistributed — this mod only adds a thin compatibility layer on top of your existing installations.
- Server-side and client-side install required on all participating clients (it uses client rendering for the zoom/lens/HUD and a small server-side hook for registration).
